title: David in the Cave of Adullam and the Massacre at Nob
description: David flees to the cave of Adullam, where he gathers about 400 men. Saul accuses the priests at Nob of helping David and orders the Edomite Doeg to kill 85 priests, but Abjathar escapes and joins David.
